PMO, as collection of routines, have a dynamic transformative nature, PfM, as an organizational capability, can also be theorized as collection of routines and PMO and PfP co transform over time.

the co evolution of two organizational capabilities: Project Management Office (PMO) and Portfolio Management (PfM).
the dynamics of PMO evolution and its relationship with organizational capabilities.
the dynamics of PMOs and portfolio management, which we theorize as routines, and the co evolution of the two.

this paper provides a new perspective to the understanding of the co evolution of the PMO and PfMs, and the dynamic nature of these two concepts in interaction with the organizational context.
